description: The donut chart illustrates the win rates of three language models—GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral—on empathetic responses as evaluated by Gemini, with the central label indicating "Win rate (%)". The chart is segmented into four distinct parts: a large dark red ring representing GPT-4o with a win rate of 98.4%, a slightly smaller blue ring also for GPT-4o showing 96.8%, a small light blue segment for LLaMA at 3.2%, and a very narrow dark red segment for Mistral at 1.2%. The labels are positioned outside the chart with lines pointing to their respective segments, and the percentages are clearly displayed next to each model name. The visual hierarchy emphasizes GPT-4o's dominant performance, with its win rate segments forming the majority of the chart, while the contributions from LLaMA and Mistral are minimal.
